calls.title: Six calls on Open Asks Sheet 99: the definition of complete, the cohort confirm, AUTB, the agriculture residual, the validate stage, the Title 5-numbered names
calls.text: The Progress view's headline pair rests on the first; the nightly confirm of the 13 authority-coded picks and the AUTB re-key wait on the second and third; the agriculture sitting, the validate column and the rename follow the others. Each ruling is recorded in the lane in the same change.
calls.if_no_reply: The pair reads settled as proposed (121 of 147), the 25 picks wait for a person on the Reference view, AUTB stays the one collision, and the names stay as the PDF read them.

next_step.title: Confirm the 26 picks a person has not confirmed, 13 of them on the authority's own code
next_step.text: Twenty-five MQ disciplines carry the code the data votes for most and one carries a code it shares; no person has confirmed them. Thirteen of them sit on the authority's own code (CCN or C-ID), which the proposed cohort confirm would settle once Sam rules; the rest are a curator's picks on the Reference view. Then the one collision (AUTB), the thirteen weak mnemonics and the two modal choices without a note, each a finding on the Progress view.

changes.text: The first run log for this reference (the Commons' step 2), so its row on the Commons tab reads a session stamp and a next step.

The Progress view: the Commons' dash for this reference, with a card for each of Sam's eight steps, the procedures under the cards and a count that opens the filtered table (the Commons' step 3, the deep link behind a count).

The daily scan runs from the daily workflow and writes kb/csr_out/latest.json with every minted identity's code: 282 codes on 75,581 identities, 110 strays on 396; its missed-alignment rule honors a recorded note, so CMUS and HIT stop asking.
The handbook's discipline is the MQ discipline on the tab and the Commons row (Sam's word); the pick's reviewer is read from the code row, so eleven picks a person made no longer read as a cohort's.
